issues.display_title: Issue #82: fix: Google OAuth users cannot set password via change-password endpoint
issues.main_description_html:
Bug

POST /v1/auth/password/change is broken for users who signed up via Google OAuth.

Root Cause

Google-provisioned accounts are created with password = "" (empty string). The ChangePassword action calls:

bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.Password), []byte(req.CurrentPassword))

Passing an empty string to bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword always returns an error, so ErrIncorrectPassword is always returned â€” regardless of what currentPassword is sent in the request. Google users can never set a password.

Affected Code

src/action/v1/auth/change_password.go

Fix

Skip the currentPassword validation when user.Password == "" (no password hash set yet). This allows Google users to set a password for the first time without providing a current password.

RESULT

Fixed ChangePassword to allow Google OAuth users (who have no password hash) to set a password for the first time.

Root cause: bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(""), ...) always returns an error, so Google users were permanently blocked from setting a password.

Fix: Skip currentPassword validation when user.Password == "".

File changed: src/action/v1/auth/change_password.go

Commit: ed06049

Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

The session-based upload endpoint POST /v1/upload has no callers — the FE uploads exclusively through POST /v1/projects/:id/file (via the Next.js /api/upload proxy). The handler duplicates ~90% of ProjectUpload logic and leaks the absolute server filesystem path (destPath) in its response body.

Why

Dead endpoints are attack surface and maintenance noise. This one also predates the role-gated project-file flow and stores files per-session instead of per-project.

Acceptance Criteria

  • POST /v1/upload returns 404 (route removed)
  • Files deleted: src/routes/v1/upload.go, src/controllers/v1/upload/upload.go, src/action/v1/upload/upload.go
  • uploadRoutes() call removed from src/routes/v1/projects.go
  • Regular upload flow from FE (/api/upload -> /v1/projects/:id/file) still works
  • Build + existing tests green

Dependencies

None

issues.display_title: Issue #78: Integrate MinIO as file storage backend
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Replace local-disk file storage with MinIO (endpoint 192.168.1.12:9199, bucket mapthru). Initialize a single *minio.Client in config alongside config.DB, configured from env: MINIO_ENDPOINT, MINIO_ACCESS_KEY, MINIO_SECRET_KEY, MINIO_BUCKET, MINIO_USE_SSL. Object keys mirror the current folder layout 1:1: {projectId}/{uuid}.ext for project files, avatars/{userId}/{file} for avatars. File serving stays stream-through (BE fetches from MinIO and streams to the client) so the FE contract does not change — MinIO sits on a LAN address browsers may not reach.

Why

Files currently live on the app server's disk: they don't survive server replacement, can't be shared across instances, and fill local storage.

Scope of change

  • src/action/v1/files/project_upload.go — c.SaveFile -> PutObject (stream from multipart, no temp file)
  • src/action/v1/files/project_get.go — disk read -> GetObject stream-through
  • src/action/v1/files/project_delete.go — os.Remove -> RemoveObject
  • src/action/v1/predict/predict.go — os.ReadFile -> GetObject; replace path-prefix validation with object-key validation
  • src/action/v1/auth/avatar.go, src/action/v1/auth/update_profile.go — same swap for avatars
  • src/action/v1/shared/shared.go — retire StoragePath() / ResolvePath() once all callers are migrated

Acceptance Criteria

  • Upload stores the object in bucket mapthru, nothing written to local disk
  • File GET, delete, avatar upload/serve, and AI predict flow work unchanged from the FE
  • No MinIO credentials hardcoded or logged; config from env only
  • App fails fast with a clear error at startup if MinIO env vars are missing
  • Build + tests green

Dependencies

Depends on #77

issues.display_title: Issue #79: Migrate existing local files to MinIO (one-shot SSE endpoint)
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Add a temporary, auth-gated endpoint POST /v1/admin/migrate-storage that walks STORAGE_PATH and uploads every file to MinIO with its relative path as the object key (1:1 with the MinIO integration key scheme). Streams per-file progress as SSE (OK {key} / FAIL {key}: {err} / final done ok=N fail=N), reusing the SSE pattern from predict.go. Idempotent — re-running only overwrites identical keys, so a second pass picks up any delta written during cutover.

Why

Files uploaded before the MinIO integration exist only on local disk and must be preserved.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Endpoint requires authentication; unauthorized requests get 401/403
  • Every file under STORAGE_PATH appears in mapthru with the correct key
  • Progress streamed per file; non-zero failures clearly reported in the final summary
  • Re-running the endpoint is safe (idempotent)
  • Post-migration verification documented: object count matches local file count + spot-check via file GET API
  • Cleanup: endpoint route + handler deleted after cutover; local disk removed only after verification

Dependencies

Depends on #78

Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Upload validation currently trusts the client-supplied Content-Type multipart header and takes the file extension from the client filename. Replace with server-side checks: sniff actual content via http.DetectContentType (stdlib) on the first 512 bytes, and derive the stored extension from the validated MIME type (map already exists in shared.go) instead of filepath.Ext(filename). Decide SVG policy: drop image/svg+xml from the allowlist, or keep accepting it but serve with Content-Disposition: attachment to neutralize stored-XSS via inline SVG script.

Why

A file that merely claims to be an image passes today's checks. SVG served inline as image/svg+xml can execute script in the user's session (stored XSS).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Genuine PNG/JPEG/WebP uploads succeed
  • A non-image file with a spoofed Content-Type: image/png header is rejected with 400
  • Stored extension always matches detected MIME, regardless of client filename
  • SVG either rejected, or never rendered inline from the file GET endpoint
  • Applies to both project-file upload and avatar upload paths

Dependencies

Depends on #78 (touches same files; do after to avoid rebase pain)

issues.display_title: Issue #81: Strip server internals from upload responses
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Upload success and error responses expose server internals: storagePath (absolute storage root) in ProjectUpload's 201 body, and storage_path in error bodies of project_upload.go and update_profile.go. Remove them. Clients only need relativePath, fileName, fileUrl, fileSize, fileType.

Why

Absolute filesystem layout is reconnaissance data for an attacker and useless to the FE (a matching FE task switches it to relativePath).

Acceptance Criteria

  • 201 response contains no absolute paths (storagePath removed)
  • Error responses contain no storage_path
  • FE upload, wizard flow, and AI generate still work (coordinate with FE task to consume relativePath)

Dependencies

Depends on #78
